absent: Arch specific derivation of mmap base and end bounds.
Maple tree empty area search internals beyond the wrapper contract.
Page table deposit and translation cache refresh effects beyond occurrence.
Collapse split and reclaim policies outside fault install and fork copy.
Userfaultfd protection semantics beyond marker preservation and clearing during copy.
Device private and migration entry lifecycle beyond fork handling.
Exact numeric order values and page size encodings for each huge page level.
Concurrency rules for address space locks surrounding gap search and fault install.

findings.text: Provides transparent huge page aware selection of an unmapped address range by first attempting an aligned placement and otherwise delegating to the generic allocator.
Chooses between bottom up and top down generic placement according to the direction flag held in the current address space.
Resolves a caller supplied search descriptor into a placement address through directional gap search and records the outcome for tracing.

Anonymous huge page orders are configured at boot by a list of size intervals bound to mutually exclusive policies, validated as a whole with atomic commit; any malformed element leaves prior configuration unchanged and is reported.
Size text is accepted only when it denotes a power of two length whose allocation order is allowed by the caller mask; otherwise validation fails.
Huge page status holds exactly for compound folios that are either the shared zero folio or marked large and remappable.

Aligned huge page placement is offered only on full width non compat execution when the file range covers a full aligned quantum and padded arithmetic stays within bounds; direct hint hits are preserved with a directional edge adjustment.
A fault installation carrier holds either a folio reference or a raw frame number, distinguished by a boolean discriminant.

Generic placement rejects oversized requests and fixed mappings directly, validates caller hints against neighbouring gaps, and applies huge page and shadow stack adjustments before directional search; the top down variant retries with the opposite direction when the first search fails.

Directional gap search reserves extra space for alignment effects, clamps the lower bound, aligns after gap reservation, and restarts past conflicting neighbours until a qualifying gap or exhaustion is found.
Huge page table installation serializes on the relevant table lock; fork duplication nests destination before source to establish a stable order.

Fault installation distinguishes absent versus occupied entries and folio versus frame number carriers, installing access and modification state with write enablement conditioned on mapping permissions and refreshing translation caches.

Fault helpers normalize the fault address to the installation granularity, require single mode frame map permissions with copy on write exclusions for raw frames, and require exact order match for folio carriers.

Fork duplication of huge entries shares the zero page, duplicates anonymous mappings with reverse map accounting, delegates migration and device private states to a non present helper, and write protects the source while filtering unhandled user fault markers.
Exposes file reverse map accounting for the larger huge page level when the corresponding huge page capabilities are built in.
Boot time entry that consumes the kernel command line option governing anonymous huge page policies.
Length and alignment arithmetic is validated for wraparound, yielding allocation failure or a neutral value that forces a safe retry path rather than a corrupted address.
Boot option staging uses a single page of initialization lifetime storage.
